when: 2026-08-03, taken on branch agent/201-idle-disperse at checkpoint 3
what: What the rule changed, measured the same way as the 'before' file and by the same harness Issue #186 built, so the two are comparable.

base.howObtained: git merge-base HEAD origin/main at the time of measurement

share.whyShareAndNotCount: the number of observed windows changed (13 -> 16) because the party takes a different course once creatures move, so absolute counts are not comparable and the share is

howLongTheLastOneTakes.meaning: ticks between the end of a wave and the first tick on which the slowest member of the cohort stands somewhere else; 60 is the whole window, i.e. it never left

thePriceNamed.why: a group that stands still is never refused a step; a group that walks is. The extra refusals are the jam of Issue #76, which the owner left on slice 6 — this rule does not fix it and does not claim to.

twoDesignDecisionsMadeByRedTests.bunksExcluded: Without the exclusion 12 simulation tests failed at once, among them Rest_jobs_are_personal_start_at_fifty_and_preempt_only_above_seventy_five and A_party_that_wins_its_fights_does_not_end_it_starving: idle bodies parked on the bunks and Move refuses a step onto an occupied tile.
twoDesignDecisionsMadeByRedTests.triggerNarrowedToTheEndOfAWave: A version that fired on any idleness sent the party across the map and back all session. prepared/20260726 ended `fallen` at t2032 with an average satiety of 0, having produced 39 meals. The food chain lost to the commute.
